# panda-ui-mithril

> Mithril.js UI component library styled with Panda CSS (atomic, type-safe CSS-in-JS). Design patterns and class naming inspired by daisyUI, Bulma, MUI, Chakra UI, and Primer. 71 components, published as `panda-ui-mithril` as a Panda preset (`panda-ui-mithril/preset`) that ships every recipe (see `src/preset.ts` → `theme.recipes`/`theme.slotRecipes`). The consuming app must use Panda CSS + Mithril.js — its own Panda install generates the CSS from the preset.

Install (npm can lag behind — prefer the GitHub repo): `bun add -d @pandacss/dev @pandacss/preset-panda` first, then `bun add https://github.com/carlos-sweb/panda-ui-mithril.git mithril`. Import the components you need from `panda-ui-mithril`, or from a per-component subpath in lowercase kebab (`panda-ui-mithril/button`, `panda-ui-mithril/alert`, `panda-ui-mithril/button-group`, ...). The consuming app configures its own `panda.config.ts` with `presets: [pandaPreset, pumPreset]`, an `include` that lists only the app's own code (`./src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}`), `staticCss: { recipes: '*' }` (emits all preset recipes), and `outdir: 'styled-system'` — its own Panda run (codegen/cssgen) then generates `styled-system/styles.css`.

Facts worth knowing before helping someone integrate this library:
- Dark mode is controlled by `[data-theme="dark"]` on any ancestor element — not a `.dark` class, and not `prefers-color-scheme`. The consuming app must set this attribute itself for dark-mode styling to apply.
- Brand colors (`primary`, `secondary`, `accent`, `neutral`, plus their `-content` pairs) are meant to be customized per consuming app: override them via `theme.extend.semanticTokens.colors.primary = { value: { base, _dark } }` in the app's `panda.config.ts`, or import/copy `panda-ui-mithril/theme` (`pumTheme`) as the base. Semantic status colors (`info`, `success`, `warning`, `error`) are fixed by design and have no override hook — they should look the same in every consuming app. (Older `--pum-*` CSS custom properties were removed; brand colors are now plain tokens in `src/theme.ts`.)
- The consuming app MUST set `staticCss: { recipes: '*' }` in its `panda.config.ts` (plus `presets: [pandaPreset, pumPreset]` and `outdir: 'styled-system'`) so its Panda emits the recipes shipped in `pumPreset`. Do NOT add the package's recipe files to `include` — the recipes come through the preset.
- Components use prop-based APIs, not CSS class composition. Variants like `color`, `size`, `variant`, `align`, `transform`, `weight`, `borderWidth` are passed as props — the component maps them to Panda-generated CSS classes internally.
- All CSS lives in `src/recipes/*.ts` as Panda `cva`/`sva` recipes. Components never contain inline `css()` calls. Recipe files are the single source of truth for every visual variant.
- TypeScript types use `PumSize`, `PumColor`, `PumStyle` (aliases for the library's own size/color/style scales).

## Component categories

### Actions (9)
Button, ButtonClose, ButtonCopy, ButtonGroup, FAB, Filter, Link, Swap, ThemeController

### Data Display (12)
Avatar, Badge, Card, ChatBubble, Countdown, Kbd, List, Mask, Stat, Table, Tag, Timeline

### Navigation (10)
Breadcrumbs, Dropdown, Drawer, Footer, Megamenu, Menu, Navbar, Pagination, Steps, Tabs

### Feedback (11)
Alert, Aura, Indicator, Loading, Modal, Progress, RadialProgress, Skeleton, Status, Toast, Tooltip

### Data Input (14)
Calendar, Checkbox, Fieldset, FileInput, TextInput, Label, OTP, Radio, Range, Rating, RatingGroup, Select, Textarea, Toggle

### Layout (13)
Accordion, Block, Box, Carousel, Collapse, Columns+Column, Container, Diff, Divider, Grid+Cell, Hero, Join, Stack

### Typography (2)
Text — text element with size, color, align, transform, weight, truncate, italic.
Title — semantic heading with size, color, align, transform, weight, truncate, italic. Renders any HTML tag via `as` prop (h1–h6, p, span, div).

## Key patterns

### Recipe system
- `cva()` for single-element components (Button, Badge, Box, Block, Container, Stack, Title, Pagination)
- `sva()` for multi-slot components (Grid+Cell, Columns+Column, Rating, Modal, Alert, Card, Calendar, List, Megamenu)
- Variants: `size`, `color`, `variant` (outline/dash/soft/ghost), `align`, `transform`, `weight`, `borderWidth`, `gap`, `spacing`, `padding`, `shadow`, `direction`, `maxWidth`
- Custom properties scoped per component: `--btn-color`, `--rating-size`, `--swap-size`, `--title-color`, `--btn-size`
- Token references use `'token(spacing.X)'` string form (NOT bare paths)
- `defaultVariants` on every recipe

### Data-driven components
`List`, `Pagination`, and `Dropdown` are prop-driven and expose the contract the future data-driven `Table` will reuse:
- `List`: `data={items}` + `render={(item, index) => vnode}` (or a single child function), `key`, `empty`, `header`, `footer`, `loading`, `loadingRows`, `hover`, `ordered`.
- `Pagination`: `page` + `pageCount` + `onchange(page)`; `variant` (joined/separated), `shape` (square/circle), `siblings`/`boundaries`, `withControls`/`withEdges`, `getHref` (items as links), controlled (`page`) or uncontrolled (`defaultPage`).
- `Dropdown`: `Dropdown` + `DropdownTrigger` + `DropdownContent`, props `open`/`defaultOpen`/`onchange`, `placement`, `trigger` (click/hover), `offset`, `width`, `closeOnSelect`/`closeOnOutside`/`closeOnEscape`; content is typically `Menu`/`MenuItem`/`MenuTitle`.

### Responsive breakpoints
Defined in `panda.config.ts` conditions: `sm` (640px), `md` (768px), `lg` (1024px), `xl` (1280px). Layout components (Box, Block, Container, Grid, Columns, Stack) use `@media (min-width: ...)` in recipe variants to scale padding/gap/columns with viewport width.

### i18n
Playground has full EN/ES internationalization. Shared translations (`common`, `sidebar`, `classRowDescs`) in `playground/i18n/shared.yml`. Per-page translations (paragraph descriptions) in `playground/pages/{name}/i18n/{en,es}.yml`. Static import map in `playground/i18n/pages.generated.js`. The `t()` function searches page translations first, then shared, then English fallback.

### Playground
73 demo pages at `playground/pages/{name}/index.jsx`. Each page imports from `../../../src/index.js`, uses `ClassTable` for variant reference, `CodeExample` for usage snippets. Sidebar categories sorted A-Z. Search modal via Ctrl+K. Font: Ubuntu via `@fontsource/ubuntu` (400/500/700 weights).

## Docs

- [Official site](https://carlos-sweb.github.io/panda-ui-mithril/): Single source of user-facing documentation — install, Quick Start, component reference and demos. The README is just a minimal pointer to it.
- [src/theme.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carlos-sweb/panda-ui-mithril/master/src/theme.ts): Source of truth for the identity values — tokens (colors, fonts, radii, spacing), semanticTokens (brand + status colors, light/dark) and keyframes. Exported as `panda-ui-mithril/theme` (`pumTheme`); the preset consumes it.

## Examples

- [Live demo / playground](https://carlos-sweb.github.io/panda-ui-mithril/): All 71 components rendered with every variant, plus copy-pasteable usage code for each.

## Optional

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/panda-ui-mithril): Published releases and version history.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/carlos-sweb/panda-ui-mithril): Full source, including `src/recipes/*.ts` — the Panda `cva()`/`sva()` variant definitions behind every component.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carlos-sweb/panda-ui-mithril/master/AGENTS.md): Contribution conventions for agents working on this repo's own source — only relevant when modifying the library itself, not when consuming it.
- [docs/audit-components.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carlos-sweb/panda-ui-mithril/master/docs/audit-components.md): CSS audit of every recipe (2026-08) — token usage (`token()` string form only), `sva` migration, custom-property naming rules. Contributor-facing, like AGENTS.md.
